assumptions.decision: Treat Issue #6 as product-neutral internal design-system governance and a representative Storybook reference, not an externally published API or branding commitment.
assumptions.reason: The Issue labels the work as a component workflow and explicitly excludes company branding, a complete product mockup, and broad component redesign.
assumptions.impact: The component profile applies unless implementation reveals a new external contract, unresolved product semantics, or another full-promotion condition.

open_findings.title: Governance guidance is not discoverable from a repository or Storybook entry point
open_findings.description: The new durable guides have no stable repository or Storybook documentation link, leaving their required governance guidance unreachable to library users.
open_findings.resolution: The root README Read next index now links both durable governance guides, and independent re-review confirmed the links plus focused and Storybook browser coverage.
